firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Rule 37.b asks that code shared publicly for this competition also be shared in its own forum or notebooks. Our write-ups for this track rely on two public releases that so far were announced only in the main competition's forum (topic 745143), so here they are:

- [gemma4-swe-kit](https://github.com/damsolanke/gemma4-swe-kit) (Apache 2.0): local tools that reproduce the scorer's request rendering, tool-call parsing, context limits and thinking budget (vLLM 0.19, Gemma 4 31B QAT), plus a model of scorer time for the 12-hour budget, a replay harness for logged contexts, and curation, rendering and training tools for harness-format distillation.
- [Gemma 4 Agent Trajectories from SWE-rebench](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/adesolanke/gemma4-swe-agent-trajectories) (CC BY 4.0, derived from Nebius's SWE-rebench OpenHands trajectories): 3,586 trajectories converted to the harness's tool format, a curated subset of 1,427 and the per-trajectory scores used to select it.

Corrections and questions are welcome in this thread.
